Synopsis:
The sadistic goblin priestess is branding new converts to the cult of the Absolute. She is a True Soul - tadpoled, but unaware that is the case. She believes she is communing directly with the Absolute.

 She's one of three leaders in the goblin camp, and an important and powerful member of the Absolute's cult. She's cruel and has a sense of superiority over her own kind. Her offers of help are really a ploy to separate players from their friends so that she can imprison them and watch as the parasite eats them alive.

Cluster Contexts:
- GOB_GoblinPriest_Branding.json: This takes place in a public conversion ritual at the goblin camp where Priestess Gut is presiding over branding new recruits into the cult of the Absolute. Gut presents the brands as a magical mark that only True Souls can see and uses her priestly authority—part carnival-barker, part sadist—to pressure people into accepting the mark. Off‑screen she’s one of the camp’s three leaders and secretly a True Soul who’s already been tadpoled, though she doesn’t realise that; she genuinely believes she communes with the Absolute. Her offers of help and friendly tone are manipulative: she aims to separate and detain people so the parasite can consume them, and companions (e.g., Gale) may react with scepticism.
- GOB_GoblinPriest_Chapel.json: The goblin priestess is branding new converts to the cult of the Absolute. She is a True Soul - tadpoled, but unaware that is the case. She believes she is communing directly with the Absolute.

She's one of three leaders in the goblin camp, and an important and powerful member of the Absolute's cult. She's charismatic and friendly, in a crude sort of way, but has an underlying suspicion and curiosity. Her offers of help are really a ploy to separate players from their friends so that she can imprison them and watch as the parasite eats them alive.
- MOO_KitchenFight_GnollMaster.json: A True Soul oversees some gnolls in the kitchen. They're uncharacteristically quiet, and she explains that the Absolute has given her the ability to 'bring out the good' in then. In truth she is simply dominating them - she'll demonstrate by forcing the gnoll to perform tricks, but we can subvert her power and let the gnoll kill her.
- GOB_DrowCommander.json: The drow commander is a True Soul, sent to the goblin camp in order to instil some discipline in the goblins and lead their raids. She's already had one success - at the tavern - but the adventurers who infiltrated the goblin camp are her next targets. The Absolute believes they have something of value, and she must reclaim it. The players can tell her that the adventurers fled to the grove in which case she'll see the players as perfect candidates to help her infiltrate the place, having mistaken them for True Souls.
- GOB_Festivities_Goblin007.json: A somewhat zealous goblin eager to tell us about the mark that the Absolute's followers have branded onto their flesh

context: This takes place during a public conversion ritual in the goblin camp where Priestess Gut—one of the three leaders—is presiding over branding new recruits into the cult of the Absolute. Gut plays the part of carnival‑barker priestess: charismatic, condescending, and cruel, presenting the brands as a magical mark only True Souls can see while jeering and pressuring people to accept them. Off‑screen she has already been tadpoled (is a True Soul) but does not realise it and genuinely believes she communes with the Absolute; her offers of help and friendliness are manipulative ploys to separate and detain targets so the parasite can consume them. Companions (for example, Gale) are likely to be suspicious of her claims and methods.
